newsitem.title: USA: Mexico buys 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico buys 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat - trade.

text.p: Mexico overnight bought 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat for March/April shipment, several U.S. exporters said.
Mexico bought 50,000 tonnes hard or spring wheat that was done for scattered March and first half April positions last night (Tuesday night), one U.S. exporter said.
"Values were rumored to have been cheap. It was probably executed as spring wheat," he said.
A second U.S. exporter said it was seller's option for U.S. spring or hard red winter wheat. He speculated the wheat would be shipped via rail.
But the price of the sale was not clear.
One exporter said he believed it could be at $168 a tonne FOB, Laredo while a third exporter thought it would be higher at around $172.00 a tonne, FOB for March 11 to April 20.
